common.fullName: National Challenge for Agropastoral and Digital Innovation
common.organizer: National Network of Chambers of Agriculture of Niger (RECA)

gallery.title: Niger's agropastoralism, in real conditions
gallery.subtitle: Livestock, market gardening, markets, villages: this is the everyday reality solutions must be designed for.

immersion.title: Design for the field, not for the demo
immersion.text: Basic phone, intermittent network, scarce energy, many languages: the best solutions start from these constraints, not the other way around.

hero.title: Agropastoral and digital innovation serving producers
hero.subtitle: CINOVA mobilizes Niger's digital ecosystem to carry agricultural information all the way to the producer — on time, in their language, on the device they actually have.

lastMile.title: The missing link
lastMile.lead: The starting point is not a lack of information, but a failure of transmission.
lastMile.body: Technical sheets, plant-health alerts, market data and agronomic recommendations already exist. They do not reach the producer at the right moment. Between the data produced and the decision made in the field lies a final step that digital tools can bridge — provided they are designed for real field conditions.

constraints.title: Real constraints to account for
constraints.equipment: Devices: many producers own a basic phone, not a smartphone.
constraints.network: Network & cost: intermittent rural coverage, expensive connectivity.
constraints.language: Language: information circulates in written French; spoken languages are Hausa, Zarma, Fula, Kanuri and Tamasheq.
constraints.timing: Timing: an alert that arrives after the decision has no value.

creation.title: Creation
creation.description: Teams build a prototype during the event, based on the challenges set by the consular network.

adaptation.title: Adaptation
adaptation.description: Owners of existing solutions adapt them to the real challenges of rural Niger.

challenges.title: Nine challenges, three selected
challenges.subtitle: Nine challenges are submitted to RECA’s technical committee, which will retain at most three for this edition. Information reliability is a cross-cutting theme across all challenges.

agroecology.title: Agroecology
agroecology.description: Support the agroecological transition through digital tools: sustainable water management, biodiversity and sharing agroecological practices.

advisory.title: Agricultural advisory
advisory.description: Amplify the reach of advice produced by the consular network.

alert.title: Early warning
alert.description: Deliver plant-health and climate alerts to the producer on time.

market.title: Market information
market.description: Reduce information asymmetry on prices and outlets.

inputs.title: Input traceability
inputs.description: Secure access to quality inputs and their tracking.

warrantage.title: Warrantage
warrantage.description: Ease inventory credit and the valorization of harvests.

cooperatives.title: Cooperative management
cooperatives.description: Equip the management of farmer organizations and cooperatives.

soil.title: Soil fertility
soil.description: Support fertilization decisions and soil management.

reliability.title: Information reliability
reliability.description: Cross-cutting theme: verify sources, keep data up to date and counter misinformation to support informed agricultural decisions.

journey.title: The journey
journey.subtitle: A mobilization sequence, not a stand-alone event.

framing.title: Framing
framing.description: Validation of challenges, datasets and rules by the technical committee.

webinars.title: Information webinars
webinars.description: Presentation of the challenge, the challenges and the evaluation criteria.

call.title: Call for applications
call.description: Online applications, with the scoring grid published at opening.

bootcamp.title: Preselection & bootcamp
bootcamp.description: Preselection by the grid, regional quota, one-day online bootcamp.

hackathon.title: 48h hackathon
hackathon.description: Prototyping in Niamey, a two-college jury, support for the winners.

audience.title: An open, national challenge
audience.subtitle: Applications are open to all regions, with a regional quota and attention to women's participation.

items.students: Students in computing, agronomy, statistics, management
items.coops: Representatives of producer organizations and cooperatives

technical.title: Technical college
technical.description: Quality of execution, feasibility and agronomic relevance.

producers.title: Producers' college
producers.description: Real usability and fit to the need — with a veto right on usability.

cta.title: Ready to take on the last-mile challenge?
cta.subtitle: Create your account, form your team and submit your application.

footer.about: CINOVA is the National Challenge for Agropastoral and Digital Innovation, led by the National Network of Chambers of Agriculture of Niger.

presentation.title: CINOVA in detail
presentation.intro: A national hackathon connecting agricultural information to the decision made in the field.
presentation.recaText: The National Network of Chambers of Agriculture of Niger federates the eight Regional Chambers of Agriculture. It combines an established body of information, consular territorial roots and the legitimacy to represent the agro-sylvo-pastoral profession.

objectives.connect: Connect Niger's digital talent to the real needs of rural areas.
objectives.build: Produce usable prototypes, designed for the field.
objectives.sustain: Identify owners able to host and sustain the solutions.
objectives.mobilize: Generate measurable engagement at every stage.

reglement.title: Challenge rules
reglement.intro: Working version — to be validated by RECA's technical committee before applications open.
reglement.draftNotice: These rules are a working version. Final amounts, dates and weightings will be set by the technical committee and published with the call for applications.
